act: Sample corpus bundled in data/sample-pdfs: LLP Act 2008, Trade Marks Act 1999, FEMA 1999, CGST Act 2017 (amended to 1 January 2022)
reviewNote: Derived mechanically from full-corpus.eval.json and full-corpus-heldout-2.eval.json: every refusal case, plus every answerable case whose accepted documents include one of the four bundled PDFs, with acceptableDocuments narrowed to those PDFs. Document ids are content-addressed (legal_ + first 24 hex characters of the PDF SHA-256), so they match the original 5,082-document index. Splits and families are unchanged. No case is lawyer-reviewed; expected facts describe the indexed text, not verified current law.
